error[ZBX-E0404]: the container did not stop in time
  while  stopping the container web-1
  cause  pid 502 was still there 5000 ms after SIGKILL was sent; a process in
         uninterruptible sleep cannot be killed until the kernel lets it go
  name   web-1
  pid    502
  fix    see what it is waiting for:   ps -o pid,stat,wchan -p <pid>
  more   zbx explain E0404
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0404.html
